newsitem.title: USA: Vertex partner starts Phase III trials.
newsitem.headline: Vertex partner starts Phase III trials.

text.p: Vertex Pharmaceuticals Inc said on Thursday that its partner, Glaxo Wellcome Plc, started a Phase III clinical trial on a drug combination for HIV-infected children.
Specifically, the trial examines the efficacy of 141W94 in combination with nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor therapy, Vertex said.
This is the second Phase III study of 141W94 in progress, Vertex said in a statement. Earlier this year, Glaxo Wellcome began a randomized double-blind trial evaluating 141W94 plus AZT/3TC in adults.
Vertex added that both studies are intended to support filing for market approval of the 141W94 compound in the United States, Europe and in other countries.
141W94 is a second generation protease inhibitor being developed by Vertex, Glaxo and Kissei Pharmaceutical Co Ltd .

"The evaluation of 141W94 with nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitors in children will enhance the positioning of the compound in the combination HIV market," said Vertex president Dr Joshua Boger.
